inputs.prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is Happy Hank's Pizza & Play: a cheap 1990s pizza-and-games party room, drop ceiling with flat fluorescent panels, laminate party tables with paper tablecloths and balloons, purple patterned carpet, arcade glow, a yellow-poled play structure with red, blue and teal tubes behind a ball pit. Ordinary, loud, a little grubby. Only children and the one mascot are in the room; no adult is ever close to the camera.
<Subject 2> is Sarah, the girl: about five, shoulder-length brown hair, blue long-sleeve top, dark grey leggings, cream velcro sneakers, a yellow star bracelet on her left wrist.

summary:
A five-second single continuous first-person shot. Sarah climbs up onto the seat of the empty chair to my right and stands on it, a little wobbly, the yellow paper crown in both hands, her face at my eye level, an arm's length away. It ends on Sarah standing on the seat of the chair to my right, an arm's length away, her face at my eye level, grinning and bare-headed; my left hand with the soda cup on the table; the crown just out of view above.

detailed_description:
First-person POV, one single continuous handheld take with no cuts; the camera is my own eyes, a tired father, and no other adult is ever near the camera. The only part of me ever visible is my own two bare hands and forearms in the lower frame; exactly two hands, never more. Sarah always looks the same: a girl of about five, shoulder-length brown hair, a blue long-sleeve top, dark grey leggings, cream velcro sneakers, a yellow plastic star bracelet on her left wrist. Photorealistic early-1990s live-action film still, shot on 35mm film with a real lens, practical sets and real physical materials: scuffed rotomolded plastic, vinyl padding, cheap carpet, nylon rope net. Natural textures and real-world scale. Flat cool fluorescent light from a drop ceiling, a loud ordinary room. Visible film grain, slight halation around lights.
Motion: the camera moves like a real person's head and body. Every move starts with a small anticipation, eases in and eases out, travels on a gentle arc and settles with a little follow-through; nothing snaps or jitters. People move with weight. The last half second holds almost still on the end state.
Exactly one child close to me: Sarah, standing on the seat of the empty chair beside me, never on the table. The crown goes on my head, never on Sarah's. My own head and face are never seen. The children at the far tables are small and always moving: eating pizza, laughing, running, waving balloons. No adult anywhere in frame.

[Shot 1] The shot opens exactly on the given first frame: Sarah standing beside my chair on my right, holding a yellow paper crown up toward me with both hands; my left hand with the soda cup on the table; the busy party and the play structure behind her. In order: 1. 0-1 s: Sarah climbs up onto the seat of the empty chair to my right and stands on it, a little wobbly, the yellow paper crown in both hands, her face at my eye level, an arm's length away. 2. 1-2 s: she leans in and sets the crown on my head; its yellow zigzag edge drops down over the top of the view, covering the upper frame. 3. 2-4 s: her two hands come in, lift it and straighten it, the zigzag edge easing back up out of the top of the frame; her tongue pokes out in concentration. 4. 4-5 s: she pats the crown, leans back on the chair seat, grinning, pleased with herself, and holds.
The shot ends on: Sarah standing on the seat of the chair to my right, an arm's length away, her face at my eye level, grinning and bare-headed; my left hand with the soda cup on the table; the crown just out of view above.

overall_soundscape:
Paper rustle, Sarah giggles, the chair creaks, party din.

non_diegetic_music:
None.

Avoid: a cut, third-person view, cartoon, anime, illustration, 3D render, CGI look, video game graphics, glossy surfaces, oversaturated colors, readable text, logos, a second adult, a stranger looking at the camera, a face close to the camera, extra hands, extra mascots, monsters, concentric rings, a tunnel of repeating circles, Sarah wearing a crown, Sarah on the table, an adult man in frame, a second girl in a blue top, steam, static frozen children, an empty or white room.
